chk_area_types_parent_level.name: chk_area_types_parent_level
chk_area_types_parent_level.value: ("platform"."administrative_area_types"."hierarchy_level" = 1 AND "platform"."administrative_area_types"."parent_type_id" IS NULL) OR ("platform"."administrative_area_types"."hierarchy_level" > 1 AND "platform"."administrative_area_types"."parent_type_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_areas_parent_presence.name: chk_areas_parent_presence
chk_areas_parent_presence.value: ("platform"."administrative_areas"."parent_type_id" IS NULL AND "platform"."administrative_areas"."parent_id" IS NULL) OR ("platform"."administrative_areas"."parent_type_id" IS NOT NULL AND "platform"."administrative_areas"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_resource_versions_published_at.name: chk_resource_versions_published_at
chk_resource_versions_published_at.value: ("content"."resource_versions"."status" = 'PUBLISHED' AND "content"."resource_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("content"."resource_versions"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' AND "content"."resource_versions"."published_at" IS NULL)

chk_resources_curriculum_parent_deps.name: chk_resources_curriculum_parent_deps
chk_resources_curriculum_parent_deps.value: ("content"."resources"."topic_id" IS NULL OR "content"."resources"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("content"."resources"."subject_id" IS NULL OR "content"."resources"."grade_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("content"."resources"."pathway_id" IS NULL OR "content"."resources"."grade_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("content"."resources"."grade_id" IS NULL OR "content"."resources"."education_level_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("content"."resources"."education_level_id" IS NULL OR "content"."resources"."curriculum_version_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("content"."resources"."curriculum_version_id" IS NULL OR "content"."resources"."curriculum_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_publication_events_rejection_reason.name: chk_publication_events_rejection_reason
chk_publication_events_rejection_reason.value: ("content"."publication_events"."event_type" = 'REJECTED' AND "content"."publication_events"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("content"."publication_events"."reason")) > 0) OR ("content"."publication_events"."event_type" != 'REJECTED')

uq_users_active_email.name: uq_users_active_email
uq_users_active_email.where: "identity"."users"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "identity"."users"."email" IS NOT NULL
